en_title: GTA 6 Has Police Departments Across America Begging People Not to Commit Crimes IRL
cn_title: 《GTA6》让美国各地警察局恳求人们不要在现实生活中犯罪
opus_summary: 《GTA6》的热度促使美国多地警方向民众发出提醒，不要在现实中实施游戏里的犯罪行为。Atlanta警方呼吁玩家将激进行为留在游戏中；得克萨斯州San Juan警方也表示，现实中的六星通缉并非挑战，而是刑事监禁。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的火爆让美国各地的警察局恳请市民不要在现实中犯罪。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is finally here, and you can carry out many of your wildest criminal fantasies. It's a very freeing experience, and Rockstar has added more depth than ever before to make crimes like simple robberies more intricate and nuanced. However, the usual suspects when it comes to a new GTA game (mainstream news outlets, like Fox News ) have expressed concern over what kind of impact this might have on society. Will it create real rampant crime or spikes in violence? Probably not, but police departments across the country have created PSAs to ask people not to commit crime.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于来了，你可以实现许多自己最疯狂的犯罪幻想。这种体验非常自由，Rockstar还加入了比以往更丰富的深度，让简单抢劫之类的犯罪行为变得更加复杂、细致。然而，每当有新的《侠盗猎车手》游戏推出时，那些常见的面孔（Fox News等主流新闻媒体）都对这可能给社会带来何种影响表示担忧。它会真的导致犯罪猖獗或暴力事件激增吗？可能不会，但全美各地的警察局还是制作了公益公告，呼吁人们不要犯罪。

paragraphs.en: The Atlanta Police Department put out a post asking people to express their more radical desires in-game and not in real life.
paragraphs.cn: 亚特兰大警察局发布了一则帖子，呼吁人们在游戏中而不是现实生活中释放自己更激进的欲望。

paragraphs.en: GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮
paragraphs.cn: 《侠盗猎车手》不是真实存在的地方，但亚特兰大是！🎮

paragraphs.en: Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions.
paragraphs.cn: 不要混淆虚拟娱乐与现实生活中的决定。

paragraphs.en: Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences.
paragraphs.cn: 酒驾、鲁莽驾驶、盗窃汽车和暴力行为都会带来现实后果。

paragraphs.en: Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets. https://t.co/Y7PdJFHLsZ
paragraphs.cn: 把这些行为留在游戏里。不要把它们带到我们的街道上。https://t.co/Y7PdJFHLsZ

paragraphs.en: The police department in San Juan, Texas have asked players to keep their behavior in-game, noting that a six star wanted level in real life is not a challenge, but a criminal jail sentence.
paragraphs.cn: 得克萨斯州San Juan的警察局呼吁玩家把自己的行为留在游戏中，并指出现实生活中的六星通缉等级不是一项挑战，而是刑事监禁判决。

paragraphs.en: It's a bit of fun to likely ride the GTA 6 hype wave. You'd be hard pressed to find a major company that isn't trying to capture GTA 6's excitement in some way right now, and it seems like even local governments are doing the same thing. As is always the case with GTA, there are some folks expressing concern over the game's contents. One concerned group in particular is the furry community , which is mocked in-game. Furries are illegal in GTA 6 and as a result, the police hunt them down and point weapons at them. It's pretty absurd, but some real furries don't find it very amusing.
paragraphs.cn: 这可能是借着《GTA6》的热潮开个玩笑。眼下，你很难找到一家没有以某种方式试图借助《GTA6》热度的大公司，似乎就连地方政府也在这么做。和《侠盗猎车手》系列一贯的情况一样，有些人对游戏内容表示担忧。其中一个感到担忧的群体是兽迷社群，他们在游戏中受到了嘲弄。在《GTA6》中，兽迷是非法的，因此警察会追捕他们并用武器指着他们。这相当荒诞，但现实中的一些兽迷并不觉得有多好笑。

paragraphs.en: This is all par for the course for this franchise, but it does seem like more non-gamers are trying to have fun with it since it's such a massive cultural event. As of right now, we don't know how well GTA 6 has sold, but it looks like it's going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history.
paragraphs.cn: 这一切对该系列来说都不出奇，但由于这是一场如此盛大的文化盛事，似乎有更多不玩游戏的人也在尝试从中找乐子。截至目前，我们不知道《GTA6》的销量如何，但它看起来将迎来娱乐史上规模最大的首发。
